papers.title: LongHorizon-Harness: Advancing Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Tasks
papers.claim: Explicit task state maintained outside context and updated only from independently verified environment facts can support long-horizon execution.

hypothesis: A read-only typed task snapshot reduces stale action and repeated discovery after a controlled environmental change and context reset.
null_hypothesis: External state provides no benefit with equal budgets and accessible evidence, or it anchors the agent to stale facts more often.
independent_variable: Transcript plus ordinary summary versus the same transcript plus a typed snapshot updated only by attributable observations.

environment.network_justification: A named model provider will be selected before preregistration.

randomness.justification: Model sampling will be frozen with the provider choice.

metrics.primary: stale-action rate after the environmental change
metrics.acceptance_rule: Do not promote fields or transition authority without inspecting every incorrect snapshot promotion.

evaluator.rubric: Label stale actions and snapshot promotions against the frozen attributable observations and task completion check.
